title: Bee Removal in Passaic, NJ
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Passaic, NJ. Licensed nest treatment and removal. Call (855) 930-5016 for service.
intro: Stinging insects in Passaic, NJ — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — build nests in wall voids, eaves, attics, and wooden structures that won't go away on their own. Whether you're in the historic Third Ward or near the Great Falls, we locate the nest, treat it, remove accessible material, and seal entry points to prevent recolonization. Fast, effective nest removal throughout Passaic.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Passaic residents for years with licensed, insured technicians who specialize in humane bee removal. pricing includes full inspection, safe colony removal, and prevention measures to keep bees from returning to your property.
localContext: Passaic's mix of vintage Victorian homes, multi-family residences, and commercial buildings near Main Avenue creates numerous locations where wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets nest in eaves, attics, soffits, and wall cavities. Carpenter bees bore into older wood trim and fascia boards. The city's proximity to the Passaic River and abundant green spaces in neighborhoods like Botany Village provide foraging grounds that draw stinging insects to nearby structures seeking nesting sites each spring and summer.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Passaic property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Passaic. Once you contact us, we schedule treatment within hours and can often complete the nest removal the same day, especially for urgent situations involving high-traffic areas or aggressive colonies.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Passaic?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: What types of stinging insects are common in Passaic homes?
faqs.answer: Passaic properties commonly encounter paper wasps, bald-faced hornets, yellow jackets in wall voids and ground nests, and carpenter bees that bore into wooden trim and fascia. Our licensed technicians identify the species and use the appropriate treatment for each — nest treatment and entry-point sealing for wasps and hornets, dust application and wood sealing for carpenter bees.
